title: Software Developer (Full Stack)
description:
What You’ll Do:
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of full‑stack developers
Design and architect scalable backend systems and secure APIs
Contribute hands‑on to frontend and backend development when required
Conduct code reviews to ensure coding standards and best practices
Collaborate with Product, QA, and Business teams to ensure timely delivery
Troubleshoot complex technical issues and drive innovation
What We’re Looking For:
Experience: 5–8 years in software development
(Minimum 3 years in a leadership role)
Skills:
Backend: PHP (Laravel), Node.js, Python, or .NET
Frontend: React, Next.js, Angular, or Vue
Databases: MS SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
Architecture: MEAN, MERN, or LAMP
Bonus: React Native or Flutter experience
Strong leadership, problem‑solving, and communication skills
Ability to work independently and deliver high‑quality solutions
Job Type: Full-time
Application Question(s):
Current Salary
Expected Salary
Which frameworks have you worked with?
Which frontend framework are you most comfortable with?
Which backend frameworks have you used?
Which Backend framework are you most comfortable with?
Work Location: In person
